title: Command Center demo red monitoring banner
description: Proves the demo-gated Farmslot monitoring banner is absent by default and present when the demo env flag is enabled on the slot sandbox.

pre_conditions.description: Command Center Vite dev server is serving the slot shell.
Gateway health endpoint responds on the slot port.
CDP browser session is available for UI proof.

open-slot-shell.intent: Open the slot shell on the sandbox UI port.

assert-banner-absent.intent: Verify the demo banner is not visible when the demo flag is off.

capture-without-banner.note: Slot shell without demo banner — reviewer before state
capture-without-banner.intent: Capture reviewer-visible proof that the shell renders without the demo banner.

restart-with-demo-flag.intent: Restart the sandbox dev stack with the demo banner env flag enabled.

open-slot-shell-demo-on.intent: Reload the slot shell after enabling the demo flag.

assert-banner-present.intent: Verify the exact demo banner copy is visible when the flag is on.

capture-with-banner.note: Red demo banner visible with exact monitoring copy
capture-with-banner.intent: Capture reviewer-visible proof of the red demo monitoring banner.
